architecture: U-Net decoder with torchvision ResNet-18 encoder

augmentation.absolute_position_mitigation: paired random reflection-pad translation up to 24 pixels; no coordinate channels
augmentation.photometric: shared current/reference brightness 0.75-1.25, saturation 0.75-1.25, hue -0.08 to 0.08

encoder.pretraining_dataset_terms: ImageNet terms; pretrained bytes are not committed
encoder.stem_adaptation: concatenate the current/reference copies of the three-channel stem weight and divide by two

output: one liquid logit per input pixel; sigmoid is liquid probability

postprocessing.clamp: reuse Approach A fillcam_masks clamp raster without modification
postprocessing.temporal_hidden_band: reuse the existing Approach A temporal interpolation rule without modification
postprocessing.vial_roi: reuse Approach A fillcam_masks vial ROI without modification

training.loss: binary cross entropy with logits plus soft Dice
